comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA aims to match 100% of global office and data center electricity usage with renewable energy by the end of fiscal year 2025, having increased its matched percentage to 44% in fiscal year 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA disclose specific renewable electricity targets and progress towards matching global electricity usage with renewable energy. Intel set a 2024 target of 95% renewable electricity use globally and linked this to executive bonuses. In contrast, NVIDIA disclosed a goal to match 100% of global office and data center electricity usage with renewable energy by the end of fiscal year 2025, having reached 44% in fiscal year 2023. While both focus on renewable energy procurement and reduction of climate impact, Intel emphasizes the year-over-year attainment target and compensation linkage for the current fiscal year, whereas NVIDIA outlines a future 100% matching goal and reports historical progression percentages.

sentences.text: In 2024, continuing our practice of linking a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to our corporate sustainability metrics, we linked a portion of the performance bonus to our 2024 target to reach 95% renewable electricity use globally.
By the end of fiscal year 2025, our goal is to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of our global electricity usage for our offices and data centers.
In fiscal year 2023, we increased the percentage of our total electricity use matched by renewable energy purchases to 44%.

comparisons.peer_topic: Executive Compensation Link to Human Capital
comparisons.peer_summary: Progress towards human capital advancements serves as a non-financial performance modifier for fiscal 2024 executive bonuses, adjusting payout by a multiple of 0.9 to 1.1.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Qualcomm both disclose the linkage of specific non-financial corporate metrics to executive performance bonuses. Intel linked a portion of executive and employee performance bonuses to a 2024 target of 95% renewable electricity use. Similarly, Qualcomm disclosed that progress towards 'human capital advancements' served as a non-financial performance modifier for fiscal 2024 executive bonuses, allowing the Board to adjust payout by a multiple of 0.9 to 1.1. While the specific metrics differ (environmental vs. human capital), the mechanism of tying executive compensation to sustainability or social goals is a shared practice in their respective disclosures.
